correctness.rationale: The finite-index K0 subcategory is extension closed, weakly idempotent complete and Frobenius; quotient exponent copies give the object-ideal factorizations and complete ideal approximations; semisimple Ext calculations give the cotorsion orthogonality; long exact cohomology yields the exact truncated-Euler obstruction and the element-order stabilization formula.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The current parity source treats only the Z/2 case and does not formulate a K0 or finite-abelian generalization. Targeted searches did not locate the arbitrary finite-abelian obstruction family or stabilization formula; older differently worded exact-category literature and concurrent follow-up work remain residual risks.

value.rationale: The result identifies the structural mechanism behind the parity counterexample, realizes every finite abelian group as an object-completeness obstruction, and quantifies each object's failure by an exact direct-sum stabilization index equal to the order of its defect class.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
